Maria Nguyen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on Wed — vendor auth + cloud regional failover. I consolidated action items. Please ack owners and ETA. Proposed owners below.

Devon: Ack. Can you paste the action list?

Maria Nguyen: Sure — 1) Rotate model-registry service tokens and add short-lived refresh flow (owner: Ash K., ETA: 2026-03-30) 2) Add region-based failover tests to CI + canary (owner: Devon, ETA: 2026-04-06) 3) Vendor SLA gap analysis + contract escalation plan (owner: Sylvie, ETA: 2026-04-13) 4) Runbook updates + run-through (owner: ops, ETA: 2026-03-27). Jira: INF-4321, INF-4322, INF-4323.

Ash K.: Taking token rotation. Will do token TTL change + add refresh endpoint. I'll open INF-4321 now.

ops-bot: New JIRA INF-4321 created by Ash K. — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4321

Devon: For failover tests — propose a synthetic traffic job that flips regions every 6h in staging. I'll prototype and wire it into the canary pipeline.

Sylvie: On SLA analysis — I'll loop in legal and procurement, and schedule a vendor call next Tue. ETA stands.

Maria Nguyen: Also flagged recurring incident pattern: auth provider spikes correlated with our daily backlog window (03:00-04:00 UTC). Action: add throttling + retry budget to the client libs. Owner: Ash K.

Ash K.: Note — adding retry budget and jitter; sample health check I'll use: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://registry.internal/api/v1/health
```
Will add tests to INF-4321 and a quick smoke script.

Devon: Can we add an observability ticket to track auth latency P95 per region? Created INF-4324 for that.

ops-bot: Reminder: Postmortem sync Fri 14:00 UTC — calendar invite sent. :spiral_calendar:

Maria Nguyen: Thanks everyone. If no blockers, post progress in the thread by EOD Fri and we'll close the loop in the sync.

Sylvie: Acked. I'll post vendor call notes into INF-4323 after the meeting. :white_check_mark:

Ash K.: Starting work today, will call out blockers early in the thread.
